Name: Adamantine Breastplate
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 124, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 464
Description: This nonmagical breastplate is made of adamantine, giving its wearer damage reduction 2/—.

Name: Advocate's Armor
Description:
This +3 glamered chain shirt is adorned with the symbol of Abadar. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks and Sense Motive checks. Three times per day, the wearer can command the armor to grant him the effects of calm emotions (DC 16) as a spell-like ability. In addition, once per day on command, the armor can create a zone of truth effect (DC 14) centered on the wearer. The wearer is immune to the effects of his own zone of truth.

Calm emotions and zone of truth are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, calm emotions, glamered, zone of truth

Name: Alchemist's Suit
Description:
This +1 leather armor is crafted with numerous hidden pockets and compartments designed to hold vials and alchemical supplies. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks and can draw alchemical items as a swift action as if she had the Quick Draw feat. Three times per day on command, the wearer can cause the armor to absorb the effects of a splash weapon that deals acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage. The armor stores this energy, and as a swift action within 1 minute of absorbing the energy, the wearer can release it as a 15-foot cone that deals 2d6 points of damage of the absorbed type (Reflex DC 14 half).

The armor can store only one type of energy at a time; if it absorbs a different type, the previous energy is lost.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, absorb elements

Name: All-Seeing Armor
Description:
This +2 mithral breastplate is etched with numerous open eyes. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks. She cannot be flanked except by a rogue of at least 10th level, and she retains her Dexterity bonus to AC even if caught flat-footed. Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the effects of see invisibility for 5 minutes.

See invisibility is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, see invisibility

Name: Aquadynamic Armor
Description:
This +1 slick mithral chainmail is crafted of fine interlocking links that seem to ripple like water. The wearer gains a swim speed of 30 feet and can breathe water as easily as air. In addition, the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement for 5 rounds.

Freedom of movement is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement, water breathing

Name: Arachnid Harness
Description:
This +1 leather harness is made of dark, glossy straps that cling tightly to the body. The wearer gains a climb speed of 30 feet and can move across vertical surfaces or even upside down along ceilings while leaving her hands free. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Climb checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can produce a web as the spell (DC 14).

Web is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, spider climb, web

Name: Arboreal Armor
Description:
This +1 hide armor appears to be crafted from living bark and fresh green leaves. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Stealth checks in forested terrain. In addition, once per day on command, the wearer can speak with plants as the spell for up to 10 minutes.

While in forested terrain, the wearer can use tree stride once per day.

Speak with plants and tree stride are CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, speak with plants, tree stride

Name: Armiger's Armor
Description:
This +2 full plate is polished to a mirror shine and often bears a noble family’s crest. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the effects of shield other for 9 rounds.

In addition, once per day on command, the wearer can use heroism on herself.

Shield other and heroism are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, heroism, shield other

Name: Armor of Fragmenting Stone
Description:
This +1 stoneplate is crafted from interlocking slabs of magically reinforced rock. Once per day as an immediate action when the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the armor shatters outward in a spray of razor-sharp stone fragments. The attacker takes 3d6 points of piercing damage (Reflex DC 15 half), and the armor loses its enhancement bonus and special properties for 24 hours as it slowly reforms.

The armor is treated as broken during this time, but it retains its base armor bonus. After 24 hours, the armor regains its full functionality.

The save DC is Constitution-based.

Fragmenting stone is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shatter

Name: Armor of Insults
Description:
This +2 breastplate constantly mutters biting taunts and crude insults directed at nearby foes. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can unleash a barrage of magically amplified insults in a 30-foot radius. Enemies within the area must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or be affected as if by hideous laughter for 1 round. A creature that succeeds at its save is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

Hideous laughter is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, hideous laughter

Name: Armor of the Pure Legion
Description:
This +3 ghost touch full plate is emblazoned with the sigil of Lastwall. The wearer gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against spells and effects created by undead.

Three times per day as an immediate action when the wearer is struck by a melee attack from an undead creature, she can force that creature to succeed at a DC 18 Will save or be staggered for 1 round.

Once per day on command, the wearer can emit a 20-foot-radius burst of positive energy that heals living creatures 5d8 points of damage and damages undead creatures 5d8 points of damage (Will DC 18 half). This effect functions as channel positive energy.

The save DCs are Charisma-based.

Channel positive energy is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ghost touch, holy aura, searing light

Name: Armor of the Sands
Description:
This +1 slick chainmail is composed of interlocking plates shaped like overlapping desert scales. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Survival checks in desert terrain and can move across sand and other loose earth without penalty.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can transform into a whirling column of sand, as if using gaseous form, except that the wearer retains a fly speed of 20 feet (perfect maneuverability) and can move through sand and earth as if under the effects of meld into stone. This effect lasts for up to 5 minutes.

Gaseous form and meld into stone are CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, gaseous form, meld into stone

Name: Armor of the Unquenchable Fire
Description:
This +3 fire resistant full plate is forged in ever-burning flame and constantly radiates heat. The wearer gains fire resistance 30.

Three times per day as an immediate action when struck by a melee attack, the wearer can wreath herself in flames. The attacker takes 4d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 18 half). This effect lasts for 1 round.

Once per day on command, the wearer can erupt in a 20-foot-radius burst of fire. Creatures in the area take 10d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 18 half).

The save DCs are Constitution-based.

The armor’s fire resistance and burst effect are CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fire shield, fireball, resist energy

Name: Backbreaker Mail
Description:
This +1 brawling chainmail is reinforced with thick metal ridges along the spine and shoulders. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on combat maneuver checks made to grapple.

Whenever the wearer successfully pins a foe, that foe takes 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage at the start of the wearer’s turn.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of enlarge person for 7 rounds.

Enlarge person is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, brawling, enlarge person

Name: Banded Mail of Luck
Description:
This +2 banded mail seems to shimmer faintly with protective fortune. Once per day as an immediate action after the wearer is struck by a critical hit, she can negate the critical hit and treat it as a normal hit.

In addition, once per day, the wearer can reroll any one saving throw after seeing the result but before the effects are applied. She must take the second result, even if it is worse.

These effects are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, divination, protection from evil

Name: Blackfingers Apron
Description:
This +1 alchemical apron is crafted of thick leather stained black from use with corrosive substances. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks.

In addition, the wearer gains acid resistance 10.

Once per day on command, the wearer can apply poison to a weapon as a swift action without risking accidentally poisoning herself.

The resistance and swift application are CL 3rd.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, resist energy

Name: Boneless Leather
Description:
This +1 leather armor is made from an unusually supple hide that seems almost fluid. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can flow like liquid for 1 round, gaining the benefits of freedom of movement for that duration.

Freedom of movement is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement

Name: Breastplate of Command
Description:
This +2 breastplate is polished to a mirror finish and adorned with symbols of authority. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can issue a mass suggestion (DC 17) affecting creatures in a 30-foot radius. This functions as the spell, except it affects only creatures with fewer Hit Dice than the wearer’s character level.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

Mass suggestion is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, mass suggestion

Name: Breastplate of the Planes
Description:
This +3 breastplate is etched with shifting planar sigils that glow faintly when exposed to otherworldly energies. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities with the air, earth, fire, or water descriptors.

Once per day on command, the wearer can use plane shift (self only).

In addition, three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of protection from energy (any one energy type) for 10 minutes.

Plane shift and protection from energy are CL 15th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, plane shift, protection from energy

Name: Breastplate of Vanishing
Description:
This +2 glamered breastplate shimmers faintly as if partially transparent. Three times per day on command, the wearer can become invisible, as invisibility, for up to 10 minutes.

While invisible in this way, the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Invisibility is CL 10th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, glamered, invisibility

Name: Buccaneer's Breastplate
Description:
This +2 mithral breastplate is engraved with nautical motifs and polished to a high shine. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Profession (sailor) and Swim checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of water walk for 7 minutes.

In addition, once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement for 7 rounds.

Water walk and freedom of movement are CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement, water walk

Name: Catskin Leather
Description:
This +2 leather armor is made from supple feline hide that moves with uncanny grace. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks and a +2 competence bonus on Reflex saving throws.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of cat's grace for 7 minutes.

Cat's grace is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace

Name: Celestial Armor
Description:
This +3 chainmail is so fine and light that it can be worn under normal clothing without betraying its presence. It is considered light armor and allows the wearer to fly once per day, as the spell fly, for up to 5 minutes.

Fly is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fly

Name: Celestial Plate Armor (3.5E)
Description:
This +3 full plate is made of shining, almost weightless metal. It is considered medium armor and allows the wearer to fly once per day, as the spell fly, for up to 5 minutes.

Fly is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fly

Name: Chain Vest of Dawn
Description:
This +1 chain shirt glows faintly with the light of the rising sun. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on saving throws against darkness effects.

Once per day on command, the wearer can emit a burst of bright light in a 20-foot radius. Undead creatures within the area take 3d6 points of positive energy damage (Will DC 14 half). Living creatures are unaffected.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

The burst is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, daylight, searing light

Name: Clockwork Armor
Description:
This +2 full plate is filled with intricate gears and whirring mechanisms. As a swift action three times per day, the wearer can activate the armor’s mechanisms, gaining a +10-foot enhancement bonus to all movement speeds and a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls for 5 rounds.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of haste for 9 rounds.

Haste is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, haste

Name: Coruscating Raiment
Description:
This +2 leather armor crackles with faint arcs of electricity. The wearer gains electricity resistance 10.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can release a 20-foot line of lightning that deals 6d6 points of electricity damage (Reflex DC 16 half).

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of fly for 9 minutes.

The save DC is Constitution-based.

Fly is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fly, lightning bolt, resist energy

Name: Crag Linnorm Plate
Description:
This +3 full plate is crafted from the scales of a crag linnorm. The wearer gains acid resistance 30.

Whenever the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker takes 2d6 points of acid damage.

Once per day on command, the wearer can exhale a 30-foot cone of acid that deals 10d6 points of acid damage (Reflex DC 19 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The breath weapon is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, resist energy, acid fog

Name: Daystar Half-Plate
Description:
This +2 half-plate gleams with the brilliance of the noonday sun. The wearer gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities cast by undead creatures.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can emit a 30-foot-radius burst of bright light that dispels magical darkness of 3rd level or lower and deals 5d6 points of positive energy damage to undead creatures in the area (Will DC 17 half). Living creatures are unaffected.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of daylight for 10 minutes.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

The burst and daylight are CL 10th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, daylight, searing light

Name: Death's Preservation Banded Mail
Description:
This +2 banded mail is etched with somber funerary imagery. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against death effects and negative energy effects.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of death ward for 9 minutes.

Death ward is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, death ward

Name: Demon Armor
Description:
This +4 full plate is forged in the Abyss and adorned with jagged spikes and demonic visages. The wearer gains fire resistance 10.

Once per day on command, the wearer can summon a babau demon, as summon monster V, to serve for 10 rounds.

In addition, three times per day on command, the wearer can release a 30-foot cone of fire that deals 6d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 18 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The summoning and cone of fire are CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fireball, summon monster V

Name: Diviner's Blight
Description:
This +1 chain shirt is etched with twisting sigils that seem to shift when observed. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against divination spells and spell-like abilities.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of nondetection for 7 hours.

Nondetection is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, nondetection

Name: Djezet Skin
Description:
This +2 leather armor is forged from rare djezet and gleams with a reddish metallic sheen. The wearer gains spell resistance 13.

Once per day as an immediate action when targeted by a spell that fails to overcome the armor’s spell resistance, the wearer can redirect the spell back at the original caster as if using spell turning, affecting only that spell.

Spell turning is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, spell resistance, spell turning

Name: Dragonform Armor
Description:
This +3 dragonhide full plate is crafted from the scales of a true dragon. Once per day on command, the wearer can assume the form of a Large dragon as if using dragonkind I for up to 10 minutes.

While transformed, the wearer retains the armor’s enhancement bonus to AC.

Dragonkind I is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dragonkind I

Name: Dragonhide Plate
Description: This masterwork full plate is crafted from dragonhide rather than metal. Dragonhide plate functions as normal full plate but can be worn by druids without violating their code of conduct.

Name: Dueling Armor
Description:
This +1 breastplate is etched with intricate patterns that shift subtly as the wearer moves. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls when making attacks of opportunity.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of blur for 8 rounds.

Blur is CL 8th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, blur

Name: Dwarven Plate
Description:
This +2 full plate is crafted in the distinctive style of the dwarves and is fitted with reinforced plates and layered steel. The wearer gains a +4 bonus on CMD against bull rush and trip combat maneuvers.

In addition, the wearer can move at normal speed in heavy armor.

These effects are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bear's endurance

Name: Elemental Bulwark
Description:
This +2 breastplate is etched with symbols representing the four elements. The wearer gains resistance 10 against acid, cold, electricity, and fire.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of protection from energy against one energy type for 9 minutes.

Protection from energy is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, protection from energy, resist energy

Name: Elven Chain
Description:
This finely crafted +1 chain shirt is so light and flexible that it can be worn under normal clothing without betraying its presence. It is considered light armor and allows the wearer to use the full Dexterity bonus to AC as if not wearing armor.

Elven chain is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace

Name: Elven Dress Uniform
Description:
This +1 mithral chain shirt is tailored as a formal military uniform adorned with elegant elven insignia. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks and Perform (dance) checks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can use charm monster (DC 17).

Charm monster is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, charm monster

Name: Elven Vengeance
Description:
This +2 elven chain is etched with scenes of ancient battles against orcs and other traditional enemies of the elves. The wearer gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC against creatures of the orc subtype and creatures with the goblinoid subtype.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of haste for 9 rounds.

Haste is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, haste

Name: Emissary’s Breastplate
Description:
This +1 breastplate is polished to a brilliant shine and adorned with the insignia of diplomatic authority. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of tongues for 7 minutes.

Tongues is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, tongues

Name: Empyreal Armor
Description:
This +3 full plate gleams with celestial light and bears the sigils of empyreal lords. The wearer gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against evil spells and spell-like abilities.

Three times per day as an immediate action when struck by a melee attack from an evil creature, the wearer can force that creature to succeed at a DC 18 Will save or be blinded for 1 round.

Once per day on command, the wearer can emit a 20-foot-radius burst of holy light. Evil creatures within the area take 5d8 points of damage (Will DC 18 half), and good creatures are healed 5d8 points of damage.

The save DCs are Charisma-based.

The burst is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, holy smite, searing light

Name: Enchanted Eelskin
Description:
This +1 leather armor is slick and faintly damp to the touch. The wearer gains a swim speed of 30 feet and a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can release a 15-foot cone of electricity that deals 4d6 points of electricity damage (Reflex DC 15 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The cone is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, lightning bolt, water breathing

Name: Equestrian Plate
Description:
This +2 full plate is specially fitted for mounted combat and bears elaborate barding motifs. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Ride checks.

While mounted, the wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of mount for 9 hours, though the summoned mount appears already saddled and barded.

Mount is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, mount

Name: Eternal Iron Breastplate
Description:
This +2 breastplate is forged from dark, unyielding iron that never tarnishes or rusts. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to resist bull rush, overrun, and trip attempts.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of stoneskin for up to 90 points of damage.

Stoneskin is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, stoneskin

Name: Fangtide Scale Mail
Description:
This +2 scale mail is crafted from the fangs and scales of monstrous sea creatures. The wearer gains a swim speed of 20 feet and a +4 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can exhale a 30-foot cone of water that deals 6d6 points of bludgeoning damage (Reflex DC 17 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The breath weapon is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, control water, water breathing

Name: Field Medic's Breastplate
Description:
This +1 breastplate bears the symbol of a healing hand and is fitted with pouches for bandages and salves. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Heal checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can cast cure serious wounds on a touched creature.

Cure serious wounds is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cure serious wounds

Name: Flashguard Plate
Description:
This +2 full plate is polished to a mirror shine and fitted with reflective plates that flare with blinding light when struck. Three times per day as an immediate action when the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker must succeed at a DC 17 Reflex save or be blinded for 1 round.

Once per day on command, the wearer can emit a 20-foot-radius burst of brilliant light that functions as daylight and dispels magical darkness of 3rd level or lower.

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The burst is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, daylight, searing light

Name: Folding Plate
Description:
This +1 full plate can be folded into a compact, easily carried bundle the size of a small backpack as a full-round action. Unfolding the armor is also a full-round action.

While folded, the armor weighs only 10 pounds. When unfolded and worn, it functions as normal full plate.

Folding plate is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shrink item

Name: Forgemaster's Half-Plate
Description:
This +1 half-plate is etched with runes of the forge and constantly radiates a faint warmth. The wearer gains fire resistance 10 and a +4 competence bonus on Craft (armor) and Craft (weapons) checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of resist energy (fire only) for 7 minutes.

Resist energy is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, resist energy

Name: Forsaken Banded Mail
Description:
This +2 banded mail is etched with grim symbols of despair and loss. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can cast bestow curse (DC 17) on a creature struck with a melee attack.

Bestow curse is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bestow curse

Name: Full Plate of the Corpse
Description:
This +2 full plate is fashioned to resemble a stitched and armored corpse. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against disease, paralysis, poison, and sleep effects.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of false life for 9 hours.

False life is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, false life, remove disease

Name: Gale Armor
Description:
This +2 chainmail is etched with swirling wind patterns. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Fly checks and a +2 competence bonus on Reflex saves.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of fly for 9 minutes.

Fly is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fly

Name: Gelugon Armor
Description:
This +3 full plate is forged from infernal iron and rimed with perpetual frost. The wearer gains cold resistance 30.

Whenever the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker takes 2d6 points of cold damage.

Once per day on command, the wearer can unleash a 30-foot cone of freezing air that deals 10d6 points of cold damage (Reflex DC 19 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The cone is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cone of cold, resist energy

Name: Gelugon Plate
Description:
This +1 full plate is cold to the touch and etched with infernal runes. The wearer gains cold resistance 10.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can release a 15-foot cone of frost that deals 4d6 points of cold damage (Reflex DC 15 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The cone is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cone of cold, resist energy

Name: Ghoul Hide
Description:
This +2 hide armor is stitched from the pallid skin of ghouls and exudes a faint odor of decay. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against paralysis and disease.

Once per day on command, the wearer can deliver a touch that functions as ghoul touch (DC 17).

Ghoul touch is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ghoul touch

Name: Giant-Hide Armor
Description:
This +2 hide armor is fashioned from the thick skin of a giant. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to resist bull rush and overrun attempts.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of enlarge person for 9 rounds.

Enlarge person is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, enlarge person

Name: Gloom Mail
Description:
This +2 chainmail seems to absorb light rather than reflect it. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks in areas of dim light or darkness.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of invisibility for up to 7 minutes.

Invisibility is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, invisibility

Name: Gossamer Shrouds of the Clairvoyant
Description:
These +1 robes are woven from nearly weightless, translucent fabric that shimmers faintly with inner light. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Perception checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of clairaudience/clairvoyance.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of see invisibility for 9 minutes.

Clairaudience/clairvoyance and see invisibility are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, clairaudience/clairvoyance, see invisibility

Name: Gravewatcher Chainmail
Description:
This +2 chainmail is etched with somber symbols of watchful guardianship over the dead. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against death effects and negative energy effects.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of detect undead for 9 minutes.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of death ward for 9 minutes.

Detect undead and death ward are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, death ward, detect undead

Name: Gray Master's Leathers
Description:
This +2 leather armor is supple and quiet, favored by elite assassins. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks and a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of cat's grace for 7 minutes.

Cat's grace is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace

Name: Gug Hide
Description:
This +2 hide armor is fashioned from the thick, rubbery skin of a gug. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to grapple and a +4 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement for 9 rounds.

Freedom of movement is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement

Name: Half-Plate of the Dark Prince
Description:
This +2 half-plate is lacquered in deep violet and adorned with sinister iconography. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Bluff and Intimidate checks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can cast suggestion (DC 17).

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of charm person (DC 15).

The save DCs are Charisma-based.

Suggestion and charm person are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, charm person, suggestion

Name: Hamatula Hide
Description:
This +2 hide armor is fashioned from the barbed hide of a hamatula devil. Whenever the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker takes 1d6 points of piercing damage.
